title: Canonical twisted hyperplane restriction and cohomology connecting maps
statement: For a field $k$, $n\geq0$, $X=\mathbf P^n_k$, a module $E$ on $X$, $d\in\mathbf Z$, and $t\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X(1))$, use the twists of [def-pc-projective-space-twist] and put $E(d)=E\otimes\mathcal O_X(d)$. Define $m_{E,d,t}:E(d)\to E(1+d)$ to be $\operatorname{id}_E\otimes\mu_t$, where $\mu_t:\mathcal O_X(d)\to\mathcal O_X(1+d)$ is multiplication by $t$ using the canonical twist multiplication. For any scheme morphism $i:H\to Y$ and modules $E,L$ on $Y$, let $T_i=i^*$ and $\eta$ be the section-normalized tensor-pullback adjunction of [def-pc-module-pullback], and let $c_i(E,L):T_i(E\otimes L)\xrightarrow{\sim}T_iE\otimes T_iL$ be [def-sc-tensor-pullback-power-comparison]. Define the canonical restriction $\rho_{i,E,L}:E\otimes L\to i_*(T_iE\otimes T_iL)$ to be $i_*c_i(E,L)\circ\eta_{E\otimes L}$. In the projective-space situation above, for any $i:H\to X$, define restricted multiplication $T_iE\otimes T_i\mathcal O_X(d)\to T_iE\otimes T_i\mathcal O_X(1+d)$ to be $c_i(E,\mathcal O_X(1+d))\circ T_i(m_{E,d,t})\circ c_i(E,\mathcal O_X(d))^{-1}$. Finally, for any scheme morphism $i:H\to Y$, modules $A,B$ on $Y$ and $N$ on $H$, and a specified short exact sequence $S:0\to A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}i_*N\to0$, fix $q\geq0$ and assume the canonical edge map $e_{i,N,q}:H^q(Y,i_*N)\to H^q(H,N)$ of [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] is an isomorphism, with cohomology as in [pqf-def-cohomology]. Define the edge-transported connecting map $H^q(H,N)\to H^{q+1}(Y,A)$ as $\delta_{S,q}\circ e_{i,N,q}^{-1}$, where $\delta_{S,q}$ is [def-sc-module-cohomology-boundary]. All these are fixed constructions; no regularity, coherence, infinitude of $k$, or closed-immersion assumption is required to define them.
